newsitem.title: UK: Chartwell offer values Archer at 35 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Chartwell offer values Archer at 35 mln stg.

text.p: Archer Group, a managing agency in the Lloyd's of London insurance market, said on Monday that U.S. based reinsurance and insurance supplier Chartwell Holdings had made a recommended offer for it of 92.5 pence per share.
This valued Archer's share capital at around 35.0 million stg, the companies said in a joint statement.
"The Chartwell Group currently owns, or has received undertakings to accept the offer, in respect of approximately 27.7 percent of the issued share capital of Archer," it added.
This includes an undertaking by "the Archer directors and certain others" to accept the offer, representing approximately 22.4 percent of Archer shares.

There is an alternative to all or part of the cash offer in the form of loan notes. The maximum amount of loan notes under this alternative, which is 1.0 stg nominal of loan notes for every 1.0 stg in cash, will be limited to 26.3 million stg.
They will carry annual interest at the rate of one percent below Libor, payable semi-annually.
The two groups said the cash offer represented a premium of 50.4 percent to the middle market quotation of 61.5 pence of Archer shares at the close of business on October 3.

"This transaction is a logical and natural extension of our existing activities in the London marketplace. Archer will provide Chartwell with significant geographic diversification and direct access to the Lloyd's marketplace for future growth," Richard Cole, chairman and CEO of Chartwell said.

Archer's chairman and CEO Bryan Kellett said the group was looking forward to joining Chartwell "who we believe will bring stability to Archer's exisiting business and assist the next stage of its development".
